sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical and magic damage taken by L+.
Reduces physical damage taken by S+.
Reduces magic damage taken by S+.
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 5.
Damage reduction scales with the number of Time elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XXL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Time elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
